notes: Retrying a write with the same request_id from the same connection, for example after a timeout: the first call applied the ask, the retry returns the first response byte for byte and applies nothing (no second subtask, thread post or lease renewal). The same request_id with any other body is refused with HTTP 409 receipt_collision and applies nothing. request_id is optional on ask, comment, record_time, record_usage, release and complete; not accepted on reads.
